def smd.FSet (α : Type) : Type :=
  Quotient (smd.FSet.setoid α)

def (sealed) smd.isFieldList (s : GoSlice) (fl : smd.FieldList) : IProp GF

def smd.FSet.ofList {α : Type} (l : List α) : smd.FSet α :=
  Quotient.mk (smd.FSet.setoid α) l

def smd.FSet.instDecidableEq {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] : DecidableEq (smd.FSet α) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((smd.FSet.all b.mem a && smd.FSet.all a.mem b) = true) ⋯

def smd.MF : Type :=
  List (GoString × smd.VSet)

def smd.Trie.brecOn_2.go.{u} {motive_1 : smd.Trie → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie) →
    Sort u} {motive_3 : smd.PE × smd.Trie → Sort u} (t : smd.PE × smd.Trie) (F_1 : (t : smd.Trie) →
    t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) → smd.Trie.below_1 t → motive_2 t)
    (F_3 : (t : smd.PE × smd.Trie) → smd.Trie.below_2 t → motive_3 t) : motive_3 t ×'
    smd.Trie.below_2 t :=
  smd.Trie.rec_2 (fun members children children_ih => ⟨F_1 (smd.Trie.mk members children) children_ih, children_ih⟩)
    ⟨F_2 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_2 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    (fun fst snd snd_ih => ⟨F_3 (fst, snd) snd_ih, snd_ih⟩) t

def smd.FieldList : Type :=
  List (GoString × smd.UVal)

theorem smd.Trie.brecOn_1.eq.{u} {motive_1 : smd.Trie → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)
    → Sort u} {motive_3 : smd.PE × smd.Trie → Sort u} (t : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) (F_1 : (t :
    smd.Trie) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) → smd.Trie.below_1 t →
    motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : smd.PE × smd.Trie) → smd.Trie.below_2 t → motive_3 t) :
    smd.Trie.brecOn_1 t F_1 F_2 F_3 = F_2 t (smd.Trie.brecOn_1.go t F_1 F_2 F_3).2

theorem smd.Trie.brecOn_2.eq.{u} {motive_1 : smd.Trie → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)
    → Sort u} {motive_3 : smd.PE × smd.Trie → Sort u} (t : smd.PE × smd.Trie) (F_1 : (t : smd.Trie)
    → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) → smd.Trie.below_1 t → motive_2 t)
    (F_3 : (t : smd.PE × smd.Trie) → smd.Trie.below_2 t → motive_3 t) : smd.Trie.brecOn_2 t F_1 F_2
    F_3 = F_3 t (smd.Trie.brecOn_2.go t F_1 F_2 F_3).2

def smd.MF.none : smd.MF :=
  []

structure smd.VSet : Type where
  set : smd.PathSet
  version : GoString
  applied : Bool

def smd.PathSet.diff (a b : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.diff a b

def smd.instDecidableEqPE.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : smd.PE) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | smd.PE.field a, smd.PE.field b => if h : a = b then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.field n, smd.PE.key fl => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.field n, smd.PE.value v => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.field n, smd.PE.index i => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.key fl, smd.PE.field n => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.key a, smd.PE.key b => if h : a = b then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.key fl, smd.PE.value v => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.key fl, smd.PE.index i => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.value v, smd.PE.field n => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.value v, smd.PE.key fl => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.value a, smd.PE.value b => if h : a = b then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.value v, smd.PE.index i => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.index i, smd.PE.field n => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.index i, smd.PE.key fl => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.index i, smd.PE.value v => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.PE.index a, smd.PE.index b => if h : a = b then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯

inductive smd.PE : Type
  | smd.PE.field (n : GoString) : smd.PE
  | smd.PE.key (fl : smd.FieldList) : smd.PE
  | smd.PE.value (v : smd.UVal) : smd.PE
  | smd.PE.index (i : w64) : smd.PE

def (sealed) smd.isMFL (M : GMap GoString GoInterface) : smd.MF → IProp GF

def smd.FSet.map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (s : smd.FSet α) : smd.FSet β :=
  smd.FSet.bind (fun x => [f x]) s

def smd.instDecidableIsEmpty (a : smd.PathSet) : Decidable a.IsEmpty :=
  smd.instDecidableIsEmpty._aux_1 a

def smd.FSet.empty {α : Type} : smd.FSet α :=
  smd.FSet.ofList []

def smd.PathSet.under (a : smd.PathSet) (e : smd.PE) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.bind
    (fun q =>
      match q with
      | e' :: r@h:(head :: tail) => if e' = e then [r] else []
      | x => [])
    a

def smd.PathSet.IsEmpty (a : smd.PathSet) : Prop :=
  smd.FSet.isEmpty a = true

def smd.Trie.paths : smd.Trie → smd.Path → Prop :=
  x✝.brecOn smd.Trie.paths._f smd.Trie.pathsC._f fun t f => PUnit.unit

def smd.FSet.union {α : Type} (a b : smd.FSet α) : smd.FSet α :=
  Quotient.lift₂ (fun x y => Quotient.mk (smd.FSet.setoid α) (x ++ y)) ⋯ a b

    IProp GF

def smd.FSet.mem {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (s : smd.FSet α) (x : α) : Bool :=
  Quotient.lift (fun l => decide (x ∈ l)) ⋯ s

def smd.flCompare : smd.FieldList → smd.FieldList → Int :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => smd.FieldList → Int) x✝¹ smd.flCompare._f x✝

def smd.Trie.brecOn_1.go.{u} {motive_1 : smd.Trie → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie) →
    Sort u} {motive_3 : smd.PE × smd.Trie → Sort u} (t : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) (F_1 : (t :
    smd.Trie) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) → smd.Trie.below_1 t →
    motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : smd.PE × smd.Trie) → smd.Trie.below_2 t → motive_3 t) : motive_2 t ×'
    smd.Trie.below_1 t :=
  smd.Trie.rec_1 (fun members children children_ih => ⟨F_1 (smd.Trie.mk members children) children_ih, children_ih⟩)
    ⟨F_2 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_2 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    (fun fst snd snd_ih => ⟨F_3 (fst, snd) snd_ih, snd_ih⟩) t

def smd.FSet.filter {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (s : smd.FSet α) : smd.FSet α :=
  smd.FSet.lift1 (List.filter p) ⋯ s

    s) :=

def smd.FSet.lift1 {α β : Type} (f : List α → List β) (hf : ∀ (a b : List α), smd.FSet.Same a b →
    smd.FSet.Same (f a) (f b)) (s : smd.FSet α) : smd.FSet β :=
  Quotient.lift (fun l => Quotient.mk (smd.FSet.setoid β) (f l)) ⋯ s

def smd.FSet.all {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (s : smd.FSet α) : Bool :=
  !smd.FSet.any (fun x => !p x) s

def smd.FSet.isEmpty {α : Type} (s : smd.FSet α) : Bool :=
  !smd.FSet.any (fun x => true) s

def smd.PathSet.inter (a b : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.inter a b

def (sealed) smd.trieOwn (p : Loc) : smd.Trie → IProp GF

def smd.PE.compare : smd.PE → smd.PE → Int :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | smd.PE.field a, smd.PE.field b => smd.gsCompare a b
  | smd.PE.field n, x => -1
  | x, smd.PE.field n => 1
  | smd.PE.key a, smd.PE.key b => smd.flCompare a b
  | smd.PE.key fl, x => -1
  | x, smd.PE.key fl => 1
  | smd.PE.value a, smd.PE.value b => a.compare b
  | smd.PE.value v, x => -1
  | x, smd.PE.value v => 1
  | smd.PE.index a, smd.PE.index b => smd.intCompare a b

def smd.Trie.brecOn.go.{u} {motive_1 : smd.Trie → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie) →
    Sort u} {motive_3 : smd.PE × smd.Trie → Sort u} (t : smd.Trie) (F_1 : (t : smd.Trie) → t.below →
    motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) → smd.Trie.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t :
    smd.PE × smd.Trie) → smd.Trie.below_2 t → motive_3 t) : motive_1 t ×' t.below :=
  smd.Trie.rec (fun members children children_ih => ⟨F_1 (smd.Trie.mk members children) children_ih, children_ih⟩)
    ⟨F_2 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_2 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    (fun fst snd snd_ih => ⟨F_3 (fst, snd) snd_ih, snd_ih⟩) t

def smd.FSet.setoid (α : Type) : Setoid (List α) :=
  { r := smd.FSet.Same, iseqv := ⋯ }

def smd.FSet.any {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (s : smd.FSet α) : Bool :=
  Quotient.lift (fun l => l.any p) ⋯ s

    smd.PE → IProp GF

def smd.FSet.bind {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (s : smd.FSet α) : smd.FSet β :=
  smd.FSet.lift1 (fun l => List.flatMap f l) ⋯ s

def (sealed) smd.trieOwnC : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.setNode → List
    (smd.PE × smd.Trie) → IProp GF

def smd.FSet.Same {α : Type} (a b : List α) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : α), x ∈ a ↔ x ∈ b

def smd.FSet.instMembershipOfDecidableEq {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] : Membership α (smd.FSet α) :=
  { mem := fun s x => s.mem x = true }

def smd.instInhabitedPE : Inhabited smd.PE :=
  { default := smd.instInhabitedPE.default }

def smd.MF.set (mf : smd.MF) (m : GoString) (e : smd.VSet) : smd.MF :=
  smd.insertKV m e mf

def smd.instDecidableEqPE : DecidableEq smd.PE :=
  smd.instDecidableEqPE.decEq

def smd.PathSet : Type :=
  smd.FSet smd.Path

inductive smd.Trie : Type
  | smd.Trie.mk (members : List smd.PE) (children : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) : smd.Trie

def smd.FSet.diff {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (a b : smd.FSet α) : smd.FSet α :=
  smd.FSet.filter (fun x => !b.mem x) a

def smd.Path : Type :=
  List smd.PE

theorem smd.Trie.brecOn.eq.{u} {motive_1 : smd.Trie → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie) →
    Sort u} {motive_3 : smd.PE × smd.Trie → Sort u} (t : smd.Trie) (F_1 : (t : smd.Trie) → t.below →
    motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) → smd.Trie.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t :
    smd.PE × smd.Trie) → smd.Trie.below_2 t → motive_3 t) : t.brecOn F_1 F_2 F_3 = F_1 t
    (smd.Trie.brecOn.go t F_1 F_2 F_3).2

def smd.Trie.CanonicalC : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie) → Prop :=
  smd.Trie.brecOn_1 x✝ smd.Trie.Canonical._f smd.Trie.CanonicalC._f fun t f => PUnit.unit

def smd.instDecidableEqVSet : DecidableEq smd.VSet :=
  decidable_of_iff (a.set = b.set ∧ a.version = b.version ∧ a.applied = b.applied) ⋯
